The build

From the first line to opening night.

Scroll, and the shop builds itself: the plan, the sketch, the shell, the joinery, the finishes, the lights. A shop at eleven in the morning. One team from the first drawing to the first sale.

The build: a shop shown in seven stages, from the first drawing to opening day, with a short note from the studio at each stage. At the end you can see our shops or start a project. You can skip the build at any time.

Motion is reduced on your device, so the build is shown as three stills: the drawing, the shell and the finished room.

11:00 · Opening day

Shop

11:00 · Shop01 / 07Skip the build ↓

  1. 01 The drawing

    Week 1 · Measured survey

    A white box with an arch. The rail takes the long wall; the fitting rooms go in the back corner, away from the door.

  2. 02 The sketch

    Week 2 · Concept

    Drawn from the door, the way a customer first sees the room: the rail, the arch, the curtains at the back.

  3. 03 The shell

    Week 3 · Partitions and making good

    Fitting-room walls framed and boarded, the arch re-plastered, the ceiling made good for the new panels.

  4. 04 Joinery & fit-out

    Weeks 5–7 · Joinery and fixtures

    The brass rail, the mirror and the curtain tracks go up. Planters and a chair are set out round them.

  5. 05 Finishes

    Weeks 8–9 · Paint, floor, fabric

    Terracotta in the fitting rooms, warm white everywhere else, a lilac resin floor and linen curtains to the ground.

  6. 06 Lights on

    Week 10 · Lighting

    Flat panels at 3,000 K and 500 lux on the rail, so the colour you see is the colour you take home.

  7. 07 Open

    Opening day · 11:00

    Doors at eleven. Everything on the rail is within reach, and every fitting room has a mirror.
